jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Together, we are Aviva.
Our values — Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence — guide how we show up for each other and for our customers. Individually, they’re words. Together, they define who we are.

At Aviva Canada
, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. We’re not just about insurance; we’re about making a real difference by protecting what matters most.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AVP, Data Science & Price Modelling
to lead a talented team that's transforming how we use analytics, machine learning, and predictive modelling to drive profitable growth and better outcomes for our customers.

In this role, you'll lead the development and delivery of advanced pricing models and data-driven solutions while partnering with teams across Pricing, Actuarial, Risk, and Technology. You'll combine technical leadership, business partnership, and people development to help shape decisions, solve complex challenges, and advance Aviva's data science capabilities. You'll have the opportunity to influence how one of Canada's leading insurers applies AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve real business challenges at scale.

If you're passionate about building high-performing teams, turning data into action, and creating meaningful business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of leaders, data scientists, and analysts, creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and do their best work.
Drive the development, enhancement, and deployment of advanced pricing models, machine learning solutions, and predictive analytics capabilities.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities where data science can improve customer outcomes, business performance, and operational effectiveness.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence business decisions.
Oversee model governance, validation, monitoring, and ongoing performance to ensure models remain effective, reliable, and aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
Champion innovation by exploring emerging technologies, analytical techniques, and industry best practices.
Work closely with Pricing, Actuarial, Risk, Technology, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions.
Drive adoption of analytical tools, models, and insights across the business to maximize value and measurable impact.
Help shape priorities, allocate resources, and deliver key initiatives that support business objectives.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative culture that encourages curiosity, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives.

What You’ll Bring

Undergraduate degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams.
Experience delivering data science and analytics solutions that solve complex business challenges and create measurable value.
Strong understanding of predictive modelling techniques, machine learning methodologies, and model development practices.
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build trusted relationships across technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience developing, implementing, and managing analytical models and data-driven solutions.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytical insights to business outcomes.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and meaningful way.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

Deep understanding of pricing analytics, predictive modelling, and machine learning within a complex business environment.
Knowledge of the Property & Casualty insurance industry and the opportunities data science can unlock.
Success building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.
Ability to connect business strategy, analytics, and technology to deliver meaningful outcomes.
Advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

What You’ll Get

Compelling rewards package including base compensation, eligibility for annual bonus, retirement savings, share plan, health benefits, personal wellness, and volunteer opportunities. 
Hybrid flexible work model.
Outstanding career development opportunities.
We’ll support your professional development education.
Competitive vacation package with the option to purchase 5 extra days off per year. 
Employee-driven programs focused on gender, LGBTQ+, origins, diversity, and inclusion. 
Corporate wellness programs to support our employees’ physical and mental health. 
Employee discount on home and auto insurance (where applicable).

The role brings together business intelligence, market analytics, strategic planning, and go-to-market capabilities to drive stronger commercial decision-making and execution. The ultimate objective is to identify and unlock growth opportunities, sharpen commercial priorities and investment, and elevate execution to deliver against Arterra’s long-term plan.

The Director will lead the development of analytics, insights, and tools that enable the business to clearly understand where to play, how to win, and where to invest, while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and senior leadership to turn strategy into measurable results. This position is based out of our Mississauga head office (hybrid work model / 3 days in office) and reports to the Vice-President of Market Strategy.

Business Performance Management. A key contributor to the monthly business cycle informing management on performance KPIs across category, volume, and market share (brand, geography, segment, pack etc.). jobs.description:
About Us

SickKids Foundation, with over 50 years of philanthropic impact is Canada's largest charitable funder of child health research, learning and care, raising over $200 million last year. As a national charity, SickKids Foundation invests in national and international initiatives to benefit children in Canada and around the world. As the fundraising partner to The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), we are aligned in supporting Precision Child Health (PCH), the future of tailoring medicine to each child's unique traits so SickKids can diagnose faster, treat smarter, and predict better.

We are driven by our core values of integrity, collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, with goals of delivering a superior donor experience, investing in our people and culture, driving innovative and sustainable fundraising, and disrupting the market through data and technology.

SickKids Foundation is committed to an inclusive culture by embedding equity, diversity and inclusion in our policies, practices, and behaviours. We aim to build awareness and skills in this area, both internally and with our partners. Our commitment extends to creating a safe, positive work environment. For details on our Equity, Diversity & Inclusion commitment, please click here.

We’re committed to attracting and retaining passionate individuals to help create a healthier future. That’s why SickKids Foundation is looking for a new Associate Director, Data Engineer.

Description Of The Position

Reporting to the Director, Data Science & Engineering, the Associate Director, Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates enterprise-grade data platforms that deliver trusted, well-governed data across SickKids Foundation. The role will help establish and evolve a production-grade cloud platform using medallion architecture principles, with a focus on reliability, data quality, cost efficiency, and scalable delivery.

As a senior hands-on technical contributor, you will set engineering standards, support platform incident response, enable self-serve analytics and AI-powered data products, and provide specialized technical guidance to data and analytics partners across the Foundation.

You will

Design, build, and operate enterprise-grade data engineering platforms using modern cloud technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks, aligned to bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture principles.
Build and maintain robust, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines with embedded validation, data quality checks, clear lineage, and repeatable delivery workflows.
Design data models and semantic layers that make trusted data accessible for analytics, reporting, and self-serve business intelligence.
Establish platform observability through query profiling, cost attribution, utilization metrics, alerting, and SLO/SLA monitoring; lead day-to-day response to data availability and performance incidents.
Define and enforce coding standards, CI/CD patterns, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to support consistent, secure, and scalable platform deployment.
Partner with business stakeholders, Data & Analytics, IT/Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate requirements into reliable platform capabilities and support appropriate access, governance, and compliance.
Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases, including natural-language querying and AI-powered data products, by partnering with stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value opportunities.
Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, AI, and emerging engineering practices, bringing relevant advancements into the platform roadmap and providing technical guidance to analysts, BI developers, and engineering partners.

Qualifications

While we know that for any job posting no one candidate will possess the qualifications being sought in equal measure, below is an outline of the qualifications we believe are important for a candidate to bring to the position or for the successful candidate to develop while in the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5-7 years of hands-on data engineering or platform engineering experience, ideally spanning the full lifecycle of architecting, building, and operating production data platforms.
Deep technical expertise with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks and strong knowledge of medallion/lakehouse architecture.
Strong data modelling and database design skills for analytics and business consumption, including dimensional modelling and semantic layers for self-serve BI.
Hands-on experience developing production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data quality, governance, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Experience establishing observability, performance monitoring, reliability standards, and incident-response practices in production data environments.
Working knowledge of AI and advanced analytics tooling, including approaches that support natural-language querying and AI-powered data products.
Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
Knowledge of foundational data domains, business processes, and enterprise applications is an asset.

We’re looking for a passionate individual who is interested in moving the dial and making a difference. We are an environment that looks to attract hardworking and committed people; people who want to challenge themselves and grow with a globally recognized brand that continues to change the world. If this describes you, consider joining our team. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Total Compensation Package

Expected Hiring Salary Range:
$99,297 - $124,121; with the ability to progress to a maximum of $142,739 with demonstrated experience and proficiency. To ensure fair and equitable pay at SickKids Foundation, placement on the salary range will be based on your years of experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the Associate Director, Data Engineer role.

To help you lead in the fight for kids’ health and to support your health, wellness, and career growth, in addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefit package (includes a flex benefit plan), tuition reimbursement, flexible work arrangements, pension plan and birth parent/parental top up – to name a few!

jobs.description:
The Klick Group
—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high-performance, people-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

About Our Technology Craft

The Technology Craft powers Klick’s platforms, products, and delivery capabilities across healthcare and life sciences. Teams design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and compliant solutions across web, CRM, data, and marketing technologies. By partnering closely with Strategy, Creative, and Client Services, the Technology Craft enables integrated omnichannel experiences that deliver real business impact.

Job Description

The Vice President, Technology (Technology Enablement) is accountable for the successful delivery of Klick’s core omnichannel technology solutions across a portfolio of healthcare and life sciences clients. Reporting to the SVP of Technology, this role provides portfolio-level delivery leadership, ensures consistent execution across teams, and builds client confidence in complex, regulated environments. The VP leads through senior Technology Enablement Leads, balancing delivery excellence, operational rigor, and scalable practices as client needs and platforms evolve.

What You’ll Do

Lead delivery execution across a multi-client technology portfolio spanning web platforms, CRM systems, Veeva, and integrated marketing technologies.
Own end-to-end accountability for technology delivery outcomes across Klick-hosted and client-managed environments, ensuring adherence to SDLC, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Client Services, Omnichannel Enablement, Strategy, Creative, PMO, and Technology leaders to align delivery plans with business and omnichannel objectives.
Act as the escalation point for delivery risk, making informed trade-offs across scope, resourcing, timing, and quality to maintain predictability and client confidence.
Evolve Klick’s technology delivery operating model by improving governance, forecasting, KPIs, and delivery standards to support scalable, repeatable execution.

Qualifications

Required:

12+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise technology solutions, with accountability for large-scale, multi-stream delivery programs.
Demonstrated leadership overseeing omnichannel technology delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe Experience Manager, or comparable enterprise ecosystems.

Planitar is looking for a VP, Finance to lead our finance function through a period of continued growth. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has operated inside a company with $100M+ in revenue, but who thrives in the scaling-company environment ($50M–$100M).

10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including prior experience at the VP level.
Direct experience with global M&A; deal evaluation, due diligence, integration, and managing finance across multiple international entities/jurisdictions.

Financial processes and controls are meaningfully more scalable and automated than when you started.
